content: hts_open (wrapper, dispatches to bgzf_open for BAM) opens the file and detects format. hts_close flushes and closes. Replacing these means: (1) open the file in Rust, (2) detect BAM/SAM/CRAM from magic bytes (we already have check_bgzf_header), (3) wrap in the appropriate reader (BGZF for BAM, plain for SAM). Depends on pure Rust BGZF (#65). For CRAM, we'd still need FFI — but BAM+SAM can be pure Rust.
